description: The plot, titled "Performance w.r.t. Temperature," illustrates the Pass@8 accuracy on the merge sets of AIME 2024 and AMC under different generation temperatures. The x-axis is labeled "Temperature" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, with tick marks at intervals of 2.5. The plot contains three solid lines representing different methods. The "On-policy RL" method is represented by an orange line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts at approximately 62.5 at a temperature of 0.1, fluctuates with a notable drop to roughly 67.0 at 0.6, reaches a peak of about 75.0 at 0.7, and ends at approximately 72.5 at 1.0. The "LUFFY" method is depicted by a red line with star markers; it begins at roughly 76.0 at 0.1, fluctuates generally between 75.0 and 80.0, hitting peaks of approximately 80.0 at temperatures 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0, where it ends. The "SFT" method is shown as a blue line with downward-pointing triangle markers; it starts at approximately 76.0 at 0.1, experiences a peak of about 77.0 at 0.5, fluctuates, and ends with a sharp decline to its lowest point of approximately 64.0 at a temperature of 1.0.
